description: This file defines an interface IGrainDirectory for grain directory implementations in Orleans, including methods for registering, unregistering, and looking up grain addresses, as well as an extension method for registration logic.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryExtension
classes.description: A static extension class providing additional functionality for grain directory registration.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Extension method to register a grain address, optionally unregistering a previous address.
